p.src: 2  Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

en: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

p.src: 3  For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

en: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

p.src: 4  Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

ja: で打ちひしがれている。
en: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
u.src: 4  Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

p.src: 5  I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.
